correctness.rationale: PASS: The final claim fixes the ground field F2, geometrically smooth quartics and conics, rational base points, intersection multiplicity exactly eight, and counts literal nonzero homogeneous forms (scalars F2^×={1}), not isomorphism classes. Reconstructed the conic-first method using all 28 geometrically smooth conics and their 84 rational point flags. Formal conic expansions modulo t^8 give eight homogeneous linear constraints on all 32767 nonzero quartic forms. An independently written GL3(F2) action checks all 168 substitutions and partitions them into 279 orbits. On each orbit representative, independent GF2 Groebner unit-ideal checks in each affine chart give exactly 78 geometrically smooth orbits, total 10920 forms. Their contact histogram is exactly h=0:9849,h=1:840,h=2:210,h=4:21, and the unique h=4 orbit has 21 forms. The two complementary searches together are exhaustive; this is a finite-field proof, not extrapolation. Bezout bounds contact order by 8 for smooth quartic vs conic.
